e.summary_en: This is a simulated insurance operator for cargo cover, describing itself in writing as the cargo insurance module of a port and logistics virtual laboratory where participants price and manage cover on shipments they build. **Measured this round**: created and pushed on the ninth of September inside the window, a repository of about one hundred kilobytes in JavaScript, no stars, no licence file, a description of about four and a half kilobytes over one hundred six lines, and a live site on a project pages host. **This entry belongs to the round theme of filling thin lines of business, because marine and cargo cover is mentioned by only a small number of entries on the site.** **Four things are worth reading: the five stages form a chain from risk assessment through quotation, payment, a cargo damage report, and a claim, and the quotation is a live premium that builds up factor by factor rather than arriving as a single number; all the numbers live in a data directory, including country risk bands, cargo profiles, and cover descriptions, so changing a rate or a risk factor means editing data rather than code; state carries from the risk assessment into the quotation, since a participant who completes the assessment finds the quotation form prefilled; and a field guide separates the three roles that are easily confused in cargo cover, namely policyholder, beneficiary, and insured, and sets out when to add the additional risks the market distinguishes.** **No page was opened and no simulated quotation was submitted this round.**
e.body:
**TTCircle Insurance**（`portvirtuallab/ttcircle-insurance`）**是一个**货运保险**的**模拟**运营体****——**逐字自述为**「**The cargo insurance module of the Port Virtual Lab**」**，**并**逐字**为**「**TTCircle is the simulated insurance operator inside PVL.ONE: participants price and manage cover on the shipments they build in the commercial, import, export and airfreight modules.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**补**覆盖薄的**业务线**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 五个环节**成链**，**而**报价**是**「**因子**逐项**堆出来的**实时保费**」**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**五阶段**：**① **风险评估**（**逐字**：**Scores the route, cargo, mode and value, and recommends a cover level.**）**；**② **报价**（**逐字**：**Full declaration with a live premium that builds up factor by factor. Submits to the Apps Script backend and returns a quote code.**）**；**③ **报告**缴费**（**逐字**：**Chat assistant: verifies the payment code, retrieves the policy, activates it and emails the certificate.**）**；**④ **货损**管理**报告**（**逐字**：**Damage report form that generates a paginated PDF for the claim file.**）**；**⑤ **索赔**（**逐字**：**Verifies the policy, uploads the evidence and registers the claim.**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 RIAA **最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**保费**由**哪些**因子**堆成**」**在**货运保险**里**是**核心**知识**，**而**这**里**它**被**做成**可**逐项**展开的**界面**——**⭐ 比**看**一张**最终**费率表**更**容易**理解**结构**。

**⭐⭐ ② 所有**数字**住在**数据**文件里**，**而**不**散**在**代码**里****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**All the numbers live in `docs/data/`.**」**（**逐字**：**Changing a rate, a country band or a risk factor is**——**⭐ 该句在 README 中即为截断**）**，**并逐字**列出 **`risk-data.json`** 的**内容**（**逐字**：**country risk bands, cargo profiles, cover descriptions**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**与**本会话**此前**记下的**做法**同源**（**⭐ 如**第 373 轮**的**规则书**与**第 375 轮**的**运行时**规则）**：**⭐ 即**「**把**可**变化的**业务**参数**从**实现**里**搬出来**」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**做**教学**或**演示**用**的**定价**工具**，**把**参数**放进**一个**数据**文件**，**就**可以**让**非**程序员**也**能**改**例子**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 上一步的**结论**成为**下一步的**初值****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**a participant who completes the risk assessment finds the quotation form prefilled**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**是**流程**设计**的**小**但**重要**的**一点**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**风险评估**」**与**「**报价**」**当成**同一条**链**上**的**两步**，**而**不**是**两个**互**不**相干的**页面**——**⭐ 对**做**产品**的人**：**「**上一步**的**输出**＝**下一步的**输入**」**通常**是**判断**流程**是否**真的**贯通**的**最小**标准**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 术语**指南**把**容易**混的**角色**与**附加**风险**分开****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**其**术语**页**为**「**the survey field guide (policy holder vs. beneficiary vs. insured, and when to add ISRCC / IWC / extraordinary risks)**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**保单持有人、**受益人、**被保险人**」**三者**在**货运**场景**里**确实**常**被**混用**，**而**「**何时**加**ISRCC／**IWC／**特别**风险**」**是**实务**判断**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**学**一条**业务线**，**先**学**它**的**角色**定义**与**附加**条款**，**通常**比**先**学**费率**结构**更**省**时间**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程**形态**与**限制****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库 **103 KB**、**主语言 **JavaScript**、**后端**逐字**为 **Google Apps Script**（**逐字**：**Submits to the Apps Script backend**）**、**页面**为**静态** `docs/*.html`**（**逐字**含 **`risk-assessment.html`、**`quotation.html`、**`payment.html`、**`cargo-report.html`、**`claims.html`、**`glossary.html`**）**；**⚠️ 而**其**许可证**字段**为空**、**且**它**明确**是**教学**实验**环境**的**模块**——**⭐ 本词条**据此**提示**：**⭐ 即**它**的**费率**与**国别**风险**档**是**教学**用**设定**，**不**应**当作**市场**费率**引用**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 覆盖**海洋**经济**与**保险**、**[[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 覆盖**货运**数据**接口**、**[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]] 覆盖**报价**引擎**参考**架构****——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**货运**承保**到**索赔**的**五步**做成**可**操作**模拟**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **保费**要**能**按**因子**展开**，**而**不**只**给**总数**；**② **业务**参数**放**数据**文件**，**实现**与**参数**分离**；**③ **流程**贯通**的**判据**是**「**上一步**输出**＝**下一步**输入**」**；**④ **先**学**角色**定义**与**附加**条款**；**⑤ **教学**设定**不**当**市场**费率**引用**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有打开**其任何**页面**、**没有提交**任何**模拟**报价**（**未**触发 **Apps Script** 后端、**未**生成**任何**证书**或 **PDF**）**，**故**不主张**其**流程**可用**、**也**不主张**其**费率**因子**结构**完整**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其**前端**代码**与 **`risk-data.json`** 内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**费率**与**国别**风险**档**的**来源**（**⭐ 本词条**按**教学**设定**理解**，**并**据此**不**引用**其**数值**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与 **PVL.ONE** 平台**其他**模块**的**关系**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**它**是**其中**的**保险**模块**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**，**而**其**页面**与**数据**是否**可**再**分发**未**核实**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该模拟体**是**教学**工具**，**不**是**承保**决定**，**也**不**是**市场**费率**参考**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐ ③ 上一步結論成為下一步初值****——**逐字**a participant who completes the risk assessment finds the quotation form prefilled**；**⭐ 即**「**上一步輸出＝**下一步輸入**」**是**流程**是否**貫通**的**最小判據**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 術語指南分開易混角色與附加風險****——**逐字**the survey field guide (policy holder vs. beneficiary vs. insured, and when to add ISRCC / IWC / extraordinary risks)**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]]、[[pingpoint-freight-mcp]]、[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把貨運承保到索賠的五步做成可操作模擬**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **保費按因子展開**；**② **參數放資料檔**；**③ **流程貫通判據**；**④ **先學角色定義與附加條款**；**⑤ **教學設定不當市場費率**。

e.body_en:
This is a simulated insurance operator for cargo cover, stating in writing that it is the cargo insurance module of a port and logistics virtual laboratory in which participants price and manage cover on shipments they build. **This entry belongs to the round theme of filling thin lines of business.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, five stages form a chain, and the quotation is a live premium built up factor by factor.** The stages score the route, cargo, mode, and value and recommend a cover level; take a full declaration with a live premium that builds factor by factor and returns a quote code; verify the payment code, retrieve and activate the policy, and email the certificate; generate a paginated damage report for the claim file; and verify the policy, upload evidence, and register the claim. **Which factors compose the premium is core knowledge in cargo cover, and here it is exposed as an expandable interface, which is easier to understand structurally than reading a final rate table.**

**Second, all the numbers live in data files rather than scattered through code.** The description states that all numbers live in a data directory and that changing a rate, a country band, or a risk factor is a data edit, naming a file that holds country risk bands, cargo profiles, and cover descriptions. **Lifting changeable business parameters out of the implementation follows the same principle recorded earlier in this session for rulebooks and runtime rules, and for teaching or demonstration pricing tools it is what lets a non-programmer change the examples.**

**Third, the previous step output becomes the next step input.** The description states that a participant who completes the risk assessment finds the quotation form prefilled. **Treating assessment and quotation as two steps in one chain rather than two unrelated pages is a small but important design point, and whether the previous output becomes the next input is usually the minimal test of whether a process is genuinely joined up.**

**Fourth, a glossary separates easily confused roles and additional risks.** The description names a survey field guide covering policyholder, beneficiary, and insured, and when to add the additional risks the market distinguishes. **Learning a line of business is usually faster by starting from its role definitions and attached clauses than from its rate structure.**

**Fifth, the engineering form and its limits.** The repository is small and written in JavaScript, the back end is a hosted spreadsheet scripting service, and the pages are static files including an assessment page, a quotation page, a payment page, a cargo report page, a claims page, and a glossary. **The licence field is empty and the module is explicitly part of a teaching laboratory, so its rates and country risk bands are teaching settings and should not be cited as market rates.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover marine economy insurance, a freight data interface, and a quote engine reference architecture, **while this entry supplies the form of a five-step simulation from underwriting through claim for cargo cover. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: expose how the premium is composed rather than only the total; keep parameters in data files and separate them from the implementation; judge process integrity by whether the previous output is the next input; learn role definitions and attached clauses first; and never cite teaching settings as market rates.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no page was opened and no simulated quotation was submitted**, no back end was triggered and no certificate or document was generated, **so no claim is made that the flow works or that its premium factor structure is complete**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the front-end code or the risk data file. **Third, the origin of its rates and country risk bands was not verified**, this entry treating them as teaching settings and citing none of the values. **Fourth, its relationship to the other modules of the laboratory platform was not verified**, the description only calling it the insurance module there. **Fifth, the repository carries no licence file**, and whether its pages and data may be redistributed was not verified. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-12 and states plainly that the simulator is a teaching tool rather than an underwriting decision or a market rate reference.**
